packs.name: Debt, liquidity, covenants and maturities
packs.boundary: Amounts, maturity schedule, covenant wording and source dates; consume Capital Structure state rather than recomputing it.

packs.name: Stock compensation and dilution
packs.boundary: Awards/expense/vesting and share-basis reconciliation; no new portfolio sizing or capital authority.

packs.name: Segments and geographic/product dimensions
packs.boundary: Dimensional maps, eliminations and reporting-definition changes; no theme or relationship graph.

packs.name: Revenue recognition and contract balances
packs.boundary: Recognized revenue, deferrals and contract assets/liabilities distinguished; period-compatible movement.

packs.name: Tax and uncertain tax positions
packs.boundary: Effective-rate/one-off/deferred-tax basis, disclosed uncertain positions, no legal conclusion.

packs.name: Leases and off-balance commitments
packs.boundary: Lease types, terms and commitments at their stated scope; avoid double counting.

packs.name: M&A, goodwill, intangibles and impairments
packs.boundary: Acquisition-date scope, purchase accounting and impairment evidence; no unsupported causal return thesis.

packs.name: Legal contingencies
packs.boundary: Allegations, disclosed ranges and procedural status separated; not probability of liability.

packs.name: Controls, auditor and going concern
packs.boundary: Explicit issuer/auditor wording, remediation and period; no fabricated fraud verdict.

packs.name: Proxy compensation and governance
packs.boundary: Compensation/performance periods and definitions, source-backed proxy observations; no voting procedures.

packs.name: Financial-institution credit/capital/liquidity
packs.boundary: Bank-specific denominators and disclosed regulatory definitions, accounting-context only.

packs.name: Biotech cash/R&D/financing disclosures
packs.boundary: Accounting disclosures and explicit static assumptions; no trial success, catalyst forecast or Grey Deer Risk model.
